headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 20, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs dominated the Toronto Blue Jays with a 16-2 victory, led by Carson Kelly's 2 hits and 6 RBIs. In other action, the Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 4-3, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-0 shutout over the Cincinnati Reds.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Michael Helman being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture. Ryne Nelson was placed on the 15-day injured list with a strained right elbow, while Wenceel Pérez was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left orbital fracture. Mike Trout was also placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain.

The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Hunter Stratton from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for catcher Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash, while the Toronto Blue Jays traded Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash.

top_news.title: **Cubs Rout Blue Jays 16-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 16-2 victory. Carson Kelly led the Blue Jays with 2 hits, including a home run, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 4-3 in a closely contested matchup. Matt Vierling led the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Yankees in Dominant 5-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a convincing 5-0 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Cam Schlittler earning the win after throwing 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Ben Rice led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Rays in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 5-2 decision to the Tampa Bay Rays, with the Rays' Griffin Jax earning the win after 5.0 innings of work, striking out 5 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Helman Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Michael Helman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture.

top_news.title: **Stratton Heads to Pittsburgh in Trade**
top_news.summary: Hunter Stratton has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates, joining the team after being acquired from the Atlanta Braves. The trade sent catcher Joey Bart to the Braves in exchange for Stratton.
